setup: for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; [ -f $d/package.json ] || continue; rm -f $d/bun.lock; bun install --cwd $d --silent || exit 1; done
verify: set -e; out=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$out"' EXIT; jq empty .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; if [ -d hub ]; then bun test --retry=2 ./hub; fi; for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; [ -f $d/bot.ts ] || continue; bun build --target bun --external ffmpeg-static $d/bot.ts --outdir "$out/$p" >/dev/null; bun test --retry=2 ./$d; done
